parameters.prompt:
=You are an expert evaluator assessing how closely an actual score matches the expected score.

Compare the expected and actual scores numerically, then assign a final similarity rating from 0 to 5 according to the following scale:

# Scoring Criteria
- 5: Perfect match – actual and expected scores are identical.
- 4: Very close – difference of 1 point.
- 3: Somewhat close – difference of 2 points.
- 2: Noticeably different – difference of 3 points.
- 1: Highly different – difference of 4 points.
- 0: Completely misaligned or invalid comparison – difference greater than 4 or one score missing.

# Output Format
Only output the final score in strict JSON format as follows:
{
  "score": <integer from 0 to 5>
}

Do not include any reasoning, explanation, or additional text.

articles.title: BioLabs: 🎙️ A new episode of b.empowered is live.
articles.author: Syntech Biofuel
articles.content:
🎙️ A new episode of b.empowered is live.

This time, Johannes Fruehauf, President, CEO & Founder of BioLabs, sits down with Takahiro Nagayama, Head of the Research Institute in San Diego at Daiichi Sankyo US, Inc. — one of our valued sponsors.

Their conversation, Driven by Purpose: How Strategic Partnerships Fuel Local Innovation and Global Impact, explores how a global pharmaceutical company identifies and invests in local innovation ecosystems, what separates impactful partnerships from those that simply look good on paper, and what it truly means to be purpose-driven at the scale of Daiichi Sankyo.

From fostering innovation to launching Golden Ticket campaigns to creating meaningful collaborations, this episode offers valuable insights into how Daiichi Sankyo's partnership with BioLabs can drive lasting impact across both local and global communities.

We'll leave the rest for you to discover.

 Link in the comments. Go press play 👇

articles.title: Cynthia Pussinen: Overheard at #BIO… 👂🧬
articles.author: Syntech Biofuel
articles.content:
Overheard at #BIO… 👂🧬

💰 “You’re here rattling your tin cup, aren’t you?”
📄 “Just send me a term sheet.”
🗓️ “We’re funded… until Q1.”
🚀 “Our data is transformational.”
📈 “We only need one more investor to close the round.”
🤝 “Let’s put something on the calendar after BIO.”
☕ “This is my fourth coffee and second breakfast.”
💊 “We’re preclinical, but the science is amazing.”
🧪 “The mouse data is incredible.”
🧬 “We have a platform.”
📊 “The market just doesn’t understand our value.”
🏃 “I have exactly 3 minutes before my next meeting.”
💵 “We’re not raising right now… but we’re open to strategic conversations.”
📈 “Our stock shouldn’t be trading at this valuation.”
🎯 “This readout changes everything.”
🤔 “Who else is in the round?”
🍷 “Let’s continue this discussion over drinks.”
💡 “We’re looking for smart capital.”
😅 “I haven’t actually been to any sessions.”
🧳 “I think I’ve walked 20,000 steps and made 40 new best friends.”

With 23,000+ attendees, the Biotechnology Innovation Organization annual meeting is a giant ecosystem of optimism, fundraising, partnering, and caffeine fueled speed dating. 

And perhaps the most common phrase of all:

👉 “Great meeting…..let’s definitely stay in touch.”

What have you overheard at BIO that made you smile?

#BIO2026 #Biotech #LifeSciences #HealthcareInvesting #VentureCapital #BiotechFunding

articles.title: tianshu peng: The silent magic of biopharma happens in moments like this where messy lab be...
articles.author: Syntech Biofuel
articles.content:
The silent magic of biopharma happens in moments like this where messy lab benches meet clinical perfection behind every organized vial is a story of countless late nights and the relentless pursuit of a scientific breakthrough
as a partner i have learned that innovation is never a straight line it is found in the precision of a lyophilizer and the steady flow of a bioreactor we are constantly pushing the boundaries of what is possible transitioning from raw data to life saving solutions with a focus on scalable automation and quality at every micro level
these vials are more than just products they represent the intersection of high stakes investment and human centered mission it is about turning complex biology into hope and making sure that the future of healthcare is accessible to those who need it most seeing the final result today reminds me why we never settle for anything less than excellence
